title: Does AI Actually Boost Developer Productivity? (100k Devs Study) - Yegor Denisov-Blanch, Stanford
summary: Yegor Denisov-Blanch of Stanford presents a study of nearly 100,000 developers at hundreds of companies, measuring how AI affects productivity from commit data. It finds an average boost of about 20% with wide variance by codebase, task complexity and stack.
why: Cited in AI-coding debates as one of the largest data-driven studies, notably for finding no correlation between self-assessed and measured productivity.

quote.text: This is a study that tries to be scientific, unlike developer self reports and CEO promises of 10x.
